Mission Local reported that MEDA was purchasing a four-story building at 2901 16th St., two blocks east of the 16th Street BART station, to convert it into 62 units of permanent affordable housing. The planned units include two single-room occupancy units, 54 studios and six one-bedroom units. The purchase depended on city approval of a project loan.
